CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 0

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 23
   D. 17

4. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 29

5. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

7. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 14

8. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

11. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 21
   D. 9

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
